Do not re-route it'), and the extraction follows it with the id and parent the maintainer's guide records. Source of LocallyAnalyticDistributions L0–L2 for the seventeen functional-analysis items. L0 plans Banach spaces of locally analytic functions with their Gauss norms, L1–L2 the distribution algebras and character spaces, which is exactly where locally analytic vectors, the LB-space structure and the compactness of restriction maps belong.

Source of PerfectoidShimuraVarieties S3 and S5 for the four items on the Hodge–Tate period map and the modular tower. S3 owns the Hodge–Tate period map on the perfectoid tower and S5 its comparison with the modular-curve tower; the items are the paper's use of exactly those.

Source of EndoscopicTransferAndUnitaryTraceComparison ET.6a and ET.6 for the seven items on the Drinfeld and Lubin–Tate towers and their cohomology. ET.6a is the two-tower cohomological realization in mixed characteristic, which is the layer that owns the Drinfeld tower the paper's supercuspidal case needs.

Source of PadicHodgeTheory R06.1 for the sixteen period-ring items. R06.1 owns C_p, its tilt, A_inf, θ and the de Rham period rings, which is what the paper's Hodge–Tate and de Rham computations consume.

Source of CohomologyComparisons CP.0 and CP.3 for the seven comparison items. CP.0 owns the comparison functors between a formal scheme, its special fibre and its adic generic fibre, CP.3 the B_dR-inverted comparison — the inputs the paper cites rather than proves.

Source of PadicDifferentialEquationsAndRigidCohomology RD.4 for the three items on the rigid cohomology of Igusa curves. RD.4 owns the overconvergent de Rham complex and its cohomology, which is the theory the principal-series description is stated in.

Source of GL2AutomorphicRepresentationsAndTransfer R16.3, R17.1 and R17.3 for the three items on the local Langlands correspondence for GL_2 and the automorphic input. R16.3 is 'Local Langlands for GL₂', which is precisely what the paper imports at those points.
Source of SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups SR.2 for the two items on smooth representations of GL_2(Q_p) and their Jacquet modules.
Source of AlgebraicModularFormsAndSerreWeights R15.2 and R15.5 for the two items on eigenforms and the Deligne–Serre lifting lemma, which R15.5 owns by name.
